dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The visible anterior margin displays an upward slope of approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon presents a smooth, convex arc with a consistent radius of curvature transitioning toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: The visible portion of the rostrum is short and thick with a low length-to-thickness ratio before occlusion by the frame boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A distinct obtuse inflection angle is visible at the transition point between the melon's slope and the rostrum's base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, parallel linear striations (rake marks) are visible on the lateral flank posterior to the cranial region.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined dark eye and a prominent contrasting white/light-colored patch on the ventral-anterior cranial surface.
